summary: Verified all 7 user-reported bugs are FIXED and ran regression checks on the Dynamo Feed static Vite+React app at 1440x900. Used /r/:slug deep links to deterministically hit each reel (feed order is shuffled per load). Headless DOM assertions via Playwright. No application code was modified.

design_issues.screen: Right column — Now reading & Watch this cards
issues: now.json still contains literal placeholder strings: 'REPLACE: book title', 'REPLACE: author', 'REPLACE: one-line take so far', 'REPLACE: show 1', 'REPLACE: one line on why'. The user said these were acknowledged as unfilled content, but confirm whether to ship real copy before launch.
[data-testid=action-like] does not expose aria-pressed; visual fill persists correctly after reload, but screen readers won't announce the liked state. Low priority.

1_sprite_pause.evidence: Clicked reel → data-testid=pause-indicator appears; CharacterSlot top position delta over 1.2s = 0px. Unclick removes indicator.

2_profile_chip_placement.evidence: On r01 chip='Dynamo Feed', r02='GitHub Campus Expert', r06='Growth and outreach'; chip IS inside [data-testid=reel-caption] on all. r03/r04/r05 have no chip (expected — r05 slug 'myth-you-need-a-referral' isn't a profile item on this profile.json). Chip click opens exactly one collapsible section and adds a sage ring (hasRing=true, openSectionsCount=1 after click).

3_marge_size.evidence: r04 Marge: character slot box height = 70.2% of reel (= 40/(1−0.43) math), VISIBLE drawing = 40.0% of reel, bottom sits 128px ABOVE caption top (no overlap). Comparable in size to Blaze/Reginald.

4_storytime_bubbles_region.evidence: r06 [data-testid=story-bubbles] bounding box spans top=8.0% to bottom=50.0% of reel (matches top-[8%] bottom-[50%] classes). Visible bubbles at beat 2 = 2 previous beats with opacities 0.65 and 0.95. No clipping.

5_speaker_name_only.evidence: [data-testid=speaker-name] values across r01-r06: 'Blaze', 'Sir Reginald', 'Blaze', 'Marge', 'Tia' — no role/personality suffixes anywhere.

6_no_duplicate_text.evidence: r06 at beat 2 caption='So instead of cold calling…'; bubbles contain only the two earlier lines. duplicateFound=false. visible = reel.beats.slice(0, beatIndex).slice(-3) confirmed.

7_stat_counter.evidence: r03 [data-testid=stat-count] reached '600' within ~2.2s after navigation to /r/the-streak and stayed at 600 on the value beat. Counter runs on its own 1.4s rAF clock in StatRevealTemplate (useEffect lines 23-38).

regression_checks.breaking_news_r01: PASS — ReelBackground two-tone fallback renders (host colour), [data-testid=news-ticker] present, lower-third 'Breaking' chip + headline bar visible, caption shows name+caption+ticker.
regression_checks.double_tap_like: PASS — double click fires [data-testid=like-burst], localStorage 'dynamo:liked:r01'='1', after reload the heart renders filled (innerHTML contains fill).
regression_checks.swipe_deck: PASS — [data-testid=swipe-deck] has 0 buttons, no 'Save'/'Skip'/'Saved N' text, tabIndex=0, drag card renders.
regression_checks.left_column_desktop: PASS at 1440 — 'Saurav Bhise', 'Pune, India' chip, 4 social circles, 4 stat cards, 5 collapsible sections all aria-expanded=false by default (Experience 4, Projects 4, Writing and research 2, Community 2, Education and certifications 3).
regression_checks.right_column: PASS — 'Off the clock' title + 'Updated 9 hours ago' + Now reading / Watch this / Volunteering / Learning Spanish cards (Writing hidden as expected since now.writing empty).

action_items: Fill in now.json 'reading' and 'watch' entries — right-column cards currently show literal 'REPLACE: book title', 'REPLACE: author', 'REPLACE: one-line take so far', 'REPLACE: show 1 / show · 2024 / REPLACE: one line on why'. Confirm whether this is pending content work (likely yes per the problem statement, which lists only structure as the requirement).
(Low) Add aria-pressed to [data-testid=action-like] so the liked state is announced; visual state persists correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FeedFrame.tsx hardcodes nothing problematic; feed order shuffles per load (feed/order.ts). Fine for a portfolio but note: deep-link testing by slug is the only deterministic way — kept in mind for future regression tests.

CharacterSlot headroom math (alloc = heightPercent*scale/(1-headroom)) is clean and the paused prop correctly short-circuits both the bob animation and Reginald's talking flip (line 46 early-return + line 106 ternary).
StatRevealTemplate's own-clock counter resets to `value` immediately when inactive — this is why the pre-mounted neighbour (±1 slot) shows 600 even without animating. Good.
StorytimeTemplate uses `visible = reel.beats.slice(0, beatIndex).slice(-3)` — correct; current line only in caption, bubbles only show previous beats.

ReelPlayer passes `paused={paused && active}` to templates (ReelPlayer.tsx line 173) — correct: an inactive reel is treated as unpaused for sprite animation purposes, but since it's inactive the parent timer isn't running anyway.
Nit: ProfileReelChip dispatches a window CustomEvent — works, but a lightweight context would be more idiomatic. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 7 reported bugs + regression checks

context_for_next_testing_agent: Feed is shuffled per load — always test specific reels via /r/:slug deep links (e.g. /r/breaking-built-by-voice, /r/the-campus-builder, /r/the-streak, /r/marge-reviews-saurav, /r/myth-you-need-a-referral, /r/the-outreach-part-1, /r/the-outreach-part-2). Only reels within ±1 of activeIndex are mounted (windowed render — feed-slot-{i}). To test the pre-mounted inactive stat-reveal counter, scroll by exactly +clientHeight from r03 instead of absolute scrollTo. All 7 user-reported bugs confirmed fixed; only remaining nit is placeholder content strings in now.json (reading & watch items) which the problem statement acknowledges as unfilled.
